blocks.orig: Become one with nature at Tembo Villas in Karatu. A series of well-appointed villas and cottages surrounded by beautiful gardens await you here with breathtaking views of the Ngorongoro Highlands. The villas are bright and spacious, with amenities such as comfortable beds, ensuite bathrooms, running water, and Wi-Fi. They are decorated in a simple traditional African style. The on-site restaurant serves a variety of delicious meals, including both local and international cuisine. Relax on your private terrace and enjoy the peaceful surroundings, have a refreshing drink at the bar, indulge in the spa and wellness centre, or cosy up by the fire pit in the evening. Being close to Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara National Park, Tembo Villas is also an ideal base for safaris in the area.
blocks.html: At Tembo Villas in Karatu you feel at one with nature. Here a collection of well-equipped villas and cottages set in lovely gardens is waiting for you, with breathtaking views over the Ngorongoro Highlands. The bright, roomy villas come with comfortable beds, ensuite bathrooms, running water and Wi-Fi, and they are furnished in a simple, traditional African style. A range of tasty meals is served in the restaurant on site, with local as well as international dishes. Unwind on your own terrace and take in the peaceful setting, enjoy a cool drink at the bar, treat yourself in the spa and wellness centre, or curl up by the fire pit in the evening. With Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara National Park nearby, Tembo Villas also makes a perfect base for safaris in the region.
